chapters.title: Calendar Reminders
chapters.subtitle: A reminder on screen before an event starts

steps.text: Calendar Reminders show a reminder on screen before an event starts, and keep it there until you dismiss it. This video shows how to set a reminder on an event, who sees it, what it looks like, and the workflow events that fire at the same moments.

chapters.title: Why reminders
chapters.subtitle: An event you cannot miss by looking away

steps.text: When you are busy in another part of the site, it is easy to miss that a meeting is about to start.
With the Calendar Reminders feature turned on, an event can remind you on screen before it starts, on every admin page you have open.
The reminder stays until you dismiss it, so you cannot miss it just by looking away for a moment.
The calendar's owner is reminded, and so is each invited user who has not declined. On someone else's calendar, only the people invited see it.

chapters.title: Set a reminder
chapters.subtitle: The Remind setting of an event

steps.text: Open Calendars, then Calendar, and choose New event. Pick your own calendar and the Meeting kind.
Give the event a title, and start it a few minutes from now. On the General card, the Remind setting says how long before the start to remind people.

You can choose No reminder, When it starts, 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes before, 1 or 2 hours before, or 1 day before. An event that takes time reminds 10 minutes before unless you change it. Here, choose 5 minutes before.
Choose Save. The reminder now waits for its time. All-day events do not remind.

chapters.title: The reminder on screen
chapters.subtitle: Stays on every page until you dismiss it

steps.text: Open pages check for reminders every minute. When the reminder is due, it appears at the top right of the page, and says how soon the event starts.
It shows on every admin page of the calendar's owner. Go to another page, and it is still there.
Choose Open calendar to see the event on its day.
Choose Dismiss, and the reminder is gone. Dismissing it on one page removes it from every other page and tab that is open.

chapters.title: Workflows
chapters.subtitle: Act at the same moments, without anyone watching

steps.text: Calendar Reminders also runs in the background every minute. It notices when an event is about to start, and when it has ended, once for each occurrence of the event.
A workflow can start at those moments, with the Calendar Event Starting Soon event, where you set the minutes before the start, and the Calendar Event Completed event.
For example, email the attendees fifteen minutes before a meeting. Building workflows with calendar events is covered in the video about calendars in workflows and AI.
Set the Remind setting on an event, and its people see a reminder that stays until they dismiss it. Thanks for watching.
